title: Mtu anaponikasirikia mimi huwa nazingatia badala ya kujilaumu

text.When someone gets angry at me, I focus o: Mtu anaponikasirikia mimi huwa nazingatia badala ya kujilaumu
text.After someone gets angry at you, do you: Baada ya mtu kukukasirikia, je, huwa unaendelea kujilaumu kwa muda mrefu?
text.Relationships 🐧 How I think when someone: Mahusiano ya 🐧 Jinsi ninavyofikiri mtu anaponikasirikia.
text.I often get really quite down when someo: Mara nyingi mimi hushuka moyo sana mtu anaponikasirikia. Lakini katika chapisho hili, nitazungumza juu ya jinsi labda kutafakari kama hiyo haisaidii timu.
text.When someone gets angry at you, do not f: Mtu anapokukasirikia, usijiangalie mwenyewe, zingatia mtu mwingine.
text.If you blame yourself and think \"someon: Ukijilaumu na kufikiria "mtu kama mimi," mwishowe unashindwa kuchukua hatua, na hiyo husababisha shida kwa jamii.
text.So, in order to contribute to the commun: Kwa hivyo, ili kuchangia jamii, bila kujali kosa ulilofanya, lazima usijilaumu na kufikiria "mtu kama mimi."
text.I heard this kind of story in a video be: Nilisikia hadithi ya aina hii kwenye video hapo awali.
text.Until now, I thought that reflecting on: Hadi sasa, nilifikiri kwamba kujitafakari ni jambo jema. Lakini ni kweli kwamba sikuzote nilitafakari kupita kiasi, na watu waliokuwa karibu nami walinitisha. Nimenaswa na wazo "mtu kama mimi ..." na siwezi kuchukua hatua za kujenga.
text.Rest like a boxer at the gong: when you: Pumzika kama bondia kwenye gongo: unapopumzika, pumzika na kila kitu ulicho nacho
text.Another tip for difficult documents at w: Kidokezo kingine cha hati ngumu kazini: soma kila sentensi kutoka kushoto
